title: Citrus Ransomware: VLESS for traffic, Sn00py for encryption, and LLMs lending a hand
summary: We break down the Citrus Ransomware group's attacks: the attackers' TTPs and tooling, including VLESS traffic tunneling and LLM use, plus their links to Toy Ghouls.

title: IT threat evolution in Q3 2026. Non-mobile statistics
summary: Key trends and statistics on malware targeting Windows and macOS computers and Internet of Things (IoT) devices in Q3 2026.

title: IT threat evolution in Q3 2026. Mobile statistics
summary: Q3 2026 mobile threat statistics for Android malware, adware, and unwanted software, plus the most notable malware found during the quarter.

title: Virtualization security: attack layers and misconfiguration impact
summary: A detailed breakdown of misconfigurations in virtual environment cybersecurity as shown by examples of ransomware cases on ESXi and Proxmox environments.

title: The SOC Files 5: Ghost in the pipeline, or a fileless SharePoint breach by Storm-2603
summary: Kaspersky researchers analyze a complex fileless cyberattack by Storm-2603 involving ToolShell exploitation and subsequent runtime subversion, and discuss how to detect such intrusions.

title: MLEP in KICS for Networks 5.0: how machine learning helps track network behavior of OT devices
summary: We explain how Kaspersky Industrial CyberSecurity for Networks uses Machine Learning Event Processor (MLEP) technology to help take inventory of assets and detect anomalies in industrial networks.

title: CyberStrikeAI in the wild: the use of AI in real-world attacks on organizations
summary: We analyze a series of attacks on educational institutions that were fully automated during the post-exploitation phase using the CyberStrikeAI penetration testing framework.

title: Filter generation in practice: from algorithms to LLMs
summary: We automate filter generation for security alerts using an algorithm, a large language model, and a group of LLM agents.

title: Unknown APT uses NetamLoader to attack a Win10 OS customized for governments in Asia
summary: Kaspersky researchers analyze a complex targeted attack employing NetamLoader, a sophisticated malicious framework and targeting a customized government OS.

title: Millions of security cameras at risk: DoS vulnerability in Intelbras devices
summary: During our research, we discovered a denial-of-service vulnerability that could affect millions of Intelbras IP camera systems built on the platform platform of a popular Chinese manufacturer.
